answer: Ephemeral Work Quota: each identity must complete a unique, verifiable task before earning, and rewards route only through a slowly refreshed oasis of shared task slots. Cloning forces the attacker to wander through fresh compute and time per clone, since cached solutions expire each epoch. A quill-signed submission log ties every payout to a distinct costly action, making each marginal clone strictly negative-EV: task cost exceeds any single payout.
